strings.en: If they hadn't appeared, we'd have crossed Karakara into Tartara!
It seems the Aura Road opened and surface machines came through.
What is happening to this Byston Well?
I don't know... But it does seem the Aura Road opens more easily now.
First the Holy Warrior Show Zama, then Todd's unit gone missing,
Are these recent disappearances due to the Aura Road opening?
Todd's unit lost contact right after encountering
those bone-like enemies that suddenly appeared.
You mean they opened the Aura Road...
